name: Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
summary: Leitner & Sohn is a financially sound family-owned C-parts (fastener) house founded in 1929, with 280 staff and EUR 139 M turnover. Our ~EUR 40 k/yr is negligible to it. It has idle capacity: the second shift has been on hold since spring and sales offered to take additional parts at short notice. Our planned single-supplier kit (P07, ~30,000 kits/yr) is exactly the volume it is fishing for, but any price move above 2 % must pass its pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

situation.decision_maker: Key account manager up to 2 % price change; above 2 % the internal pricing committee (meets every two weeks)

negotiation_pattern: Every year in Nov/Dec it opens with a ritual 1.2–3.6 % increase request (mean 2.47 %). It settled at 0 % in 8 of 9 renewals; the only exception was +1.5 % on washers for 2024. It folds without escalation and never pushed back hard. Current prices (valid 2026-01-01) are below its own 2025 RFQ quotes for all three parts, so it accepted lower prices than it quoted.
wants: additional volume to refill the idle second shift (kit consolidation incl. part:360011)
volume and forecast security over a longer contract term
reliable on-time payment at 30 days net (we pay late on 75 % of invoices, mean 2 days)
a modest increase or at least price stability for 2027
protects: unit_price cuts above 2 % in one step (pricing committee approval needed, 2-week cycle)
payment_days (already 30 net, no skonto offered; little reason to extend while we pay late)
incoterm DAP / 5-day lead time are already standard; little to gain there

trades.give: volume_per_year up: 100 % kit share of part:360010, part:360012, part:360030 plus award of part:360011 (M16x60)
trades.get: unit_price down on all kit parts from 2027-01-01 (aim beyond 2 %, accept staged: ≤2 % at KAM level now, the rest via committee)
trades.why: At ~30,000 kits/yr, our volume on the three current parts rises roughly 2.5x vs today's 30–50 % quotas, which fills idle shift capacity.

trades.give: contract_months longer: extend ctr:4600070610 beyond 2027-06-30 (e.g. 24–36 months for the kit)
trades.get: unit_price fixed for 2027 and 2028, no index_clause, no 2027 increase
trades.why: A family firm with idle capacity values long, steady volume more than a 1–2 % uplift it historically never gets anyway.

trades.give: payment discipline: commit to strict 30 days net (end our late payments)
trades.get: waiver of any 2027 increase request / 0 % renewal
trades.why: This costs us nothing in contract terms, removes its only real grievance, and buys goodwill with an owner-led firm.

trades.give: rolling 12-month kit forecast and call-off schedule
trades.get: OTD commitment to the contractual 95 % (currently 88.6 %) and ppm_commitment ≤ 50 with chargeback EUR 150 per complaint retained
trades.why: Single-sourcing the kit only works if delivery improves, and a forecast lets it plan the restarted shift.

arguments.point: We can fill your idle second shift: one supplier for the whole kit, about 30,000 kits a year, roughly 2.5x today's volume on your three parts plus the M16 bolt.
The bundle price must reflect the scale effect. Your current prices already sit below your 2025 quotes, which shows there is room.
Price changes for 2027 need written notice 90 days before year end (≈2 Oct 2026). Absent notice, 2027 prices stay as they are, so the starting point is 0 % plus a bundle discount.
OTD of 88.6 % is below the contractual 95 % target. Winning the full kit requires closing that gap.
Each part already has an alternative source, so the kit award is contestable.

avoid: Posing as a key customer or threatening volume loss as leverage: we are ~0 % of its turnover.
Demanding a large price cut for an immediate yes. Anything above 2 % needs the pricing committee, so leave a 2-week window or split the ask.
Asking for longer payment_days or skonto while we pay 75 % of invoices late.
Framing quality as a crisis: it is class A / green. Use the OTD gap as a condition, not an accusation.
Hard-pressure tactics: it is an owner-led family firm that has always settled quietly; respect works better.
tone: Friendly, respectful and partnership-oriented. Lead with the growth opportunity (kit), be concrete on volumes and dates, and keep each price ask structured so the KAM can sign ≤2 % or table it with the committee.
red_flags: OTD stuck at 87.5–88.6 % vs 95 % target. Single-sourcing the kit concentrates line-stop risk unless a delivery commitment is secured.
ppm rose to 85 in 2026Q2 (now 68); 19 complaints in the last 12 months.
part:360011 (M16x60) is not in our current scope with this supplier: no price or quote on file, so an RFQ is needed.
The 2027 price-change notice deadline (~2 Oct 2026) is imminent; expect its routine increase letter now.
Our late payments weaken our position if it raises them.

evidence.claim: Second shift on hold since spring; can take additional parts at short notice
Price changes above 2 % need pricing committee approval, which meets every two weeks
Kit plan: about 30,000 kits/yr with 19x M12 bolt, 6x M16 bolt, 21x M12 nut and 23x washer per kit, from one supplier
Asked 1.2–3.6 % in each renewal, settled 0 % in 8 of 9; only +1.5 % on washers for 2024
Prices are fixed per calendar year; changes need 90 days' notice before year end
Framework runs to 2027-06-30 with 12-month auto-extension and 90 days' notice
OTD 88.6 % vs 95 % target; ppm 68; class A green
Current prices sit below its 2025 RFQ quotes (12.46 vs 12.68; 4.91 vs 4.96; 12.78 vs 13.06)

indicators.credit_index: 179 (12 months ago 179; higher is worse, >300 weak)
indicators.scorecard_trend: 2025Q4 green (otd 87.5, ppm 54) → 2026Q1 green (otd 88.6, ppm 58) → 2026Q2 green (otd 88.6, ppm 85) → 2026Q3 green (otd 88.6, ppm 68)
